tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the ISO 20022 catalogue by use-case, message type or keyword (e.g. 'reconciliation', 'make a payment', 'pacs.008') and get the matching message types, their family, and which package provides them.

query.description: Use-case, message type or keyword. Empty = all.
query.title: Query

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: List every ISO 20022 family the gateway routes to (pain, pacs, camt, acmt): its capabilities, backing package, and whether that package is installed in this environment.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List the whole ISO 20022 suite the gateway knows: the message families (pain/pacs/camt/acmt), the Exceptions & Investigations messages (camt.056/camt.029), and the specialized servers (reconciliation, agent-payment bridge) with what each does.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Describe a message type: its required fields and input JSON Schema, resolved from the family's backing server.

message_type.description: ISO 20022 message type or family prefix, e.g. 'pacs.008' or 'camt.053'.
message_type.title: Message Type

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate records for a message type against its JSON Schema, via the family's backing server.

message_type.description: ISO 20022 message type or family prefix, e.g. 'pacs.008' or 'camt.053'.
message_type.title: Message Type

records.description: List of record objects to validate or generate a message from.
records.title: Records

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate a validated ISO 20022 XML message from records. Supported for initiation and interbank families (pain, pacs, acmt); statement families (camt) are inbound-only and return an explanatory error.

message_type.description: ISO 20022 message type or family prefix, e.g. 'pacs.008' or 'camt.053'.
message_type.title: Message Type

records.description: List of record objects to validate or generate a message from.
records.title: Records

tools.name: parse
tools.description: Parse an inbound ISO 20022 XML message into structured data. Supported for interbank (pacs) and statement (camt) families; initiation families return an explanatory error.

message_type.description: ISO 20022 message type or family prefix, e.g. 'pacs.008' or 'camt.053'.
message_type.title: Message Type
